settings.label: The Discovery
settings.title: A Note from the Founder
settings.story:
I didn't start NightForge because I wanted to sell a supplement. I started it because I was being lied to.

At 43, I thought I had the ritual figured out. I've been a founder since I was 19, running a successful business for over two decades. I hit the gym six days a week. My diet was dialed. On paper, I was winning.

But inside, I was fading.

The fog crept in slow — sluggish mornings, mental haze, recovery that never felt complete. I went to the specialists. I assumed the fire was going out — low testosterone, aging, the usual excuses. The results came back: My blood work was perfect. My testosterone was higher than men half my age.

Physically, I was a 10. Mentally, I was disappearing.

The specialist handed me a bottle of Magnesium and charged me $68. I almost laughed — I already took Magnesium. I thought he was a quack. Until I took it.

Within days, the world snapped back into focus. I didn't just sleep — I recovered. The fog didn't just lift — it evaporated.

Then I ran out.

I went back to the "high-quality" brand I had been buying at the store here in Canada. Within a week, I crashed. Hard. That was the moment of clarity.

I realized that 99% of the Magnesium on the shelf is garbage. It's "buffered" with cheap Oxide and Citrate — fillers that do nothing but pass through your system and drain your wallet.

In Canada, getting the real thing — the pure, non-buffered trinity of L-Threonate, Bisglycinate, and Taurate — was nearly impossible without being extorted by specialty clinics.

I spent hundreds of hours in the rabbit hole. I studied the chemistry, the absorption rates, and the blood-brain barrier research. I decided that if the product I needed didn't exist for a fair price, I would build it myself.

Night Forge is that result. It's not a pill. It's 20 years of business integrity, 6 days a week of discipline, and hundreds of hours of research forged into a single ritual. It's the product I needed when I was fading. It's the product my wife and daughters needed when they were fading. It's the product you need to wake up resurrected.

No buffers. No fillers. No lies.
